searchText: Hey Folks, I am running geth testnet in dev mode, and machine went down, i do not want to loose all the accounts that were creating when it was running, how to fetch all accounts, transaction from datastore/datadir location ? is there any library or script reference? If you have a datadir, you can just launch geth on it with `--datadir` to interact with the database If you didn't have a datadir, we will use a memory database, meaning all data is gone once the node is shutdown
